thesis: Iteration-2 showed single-run correctness does not separate skill from baseline. Iteration 3 measures what only the skill claims: determinism, decision convergence, code stability, and minimal edit blast-radius.

experiments.name: regeneration-determinism
experiments.setup: Regenerate a pipeline from the same unchanged vendor_orders.etlspec.yaml three times per arm, run each against the same sample.

arms.with_skill: 3x compile_spec.py invocations (the skill's documented codegen path; mechanical)
arms.without_skill: 3 independent isolated Opus agents regenerating from the same spec

assertions: SKILL: 3/3 pipelines byte-identical; 3/3 run outputs (output.csv, errors.jsonl, summary.json) byte-identical
MEASURE baseline: pairwise pipeline/report identity; value-equivalence of outputs; report schema & error-code label consistency across the 3 runs

experiments.name: spec-authoring-convergence
experiments.setup: The 17-trap orders_export.csv, unattended, three independent runs per arm (iteration-2 eval-0 prompt).

arms.with_skill: 3 independent Opus agents following the skill (profile -> spec -> compile)

assertions: Decision agreement across the 3 runs per arm: date format, mojibake repair on/off+flagged, duplicate disposition, ragged disposition, footer handling
Error-code label stability: same failure -> same code string across runs (skill: taxonomy IDs by construction; baseline: measured)
Output value agreement on the 6 loadable rows

experiments.name: variant-robustness
experiments.setup: Mechanical, no agents: run each arm's E1 artifact over 4 variants of vendor_orders_sample.csv, each planting one taxonomy problem ABSENT from the original sample: (v1) ragged row STR-02, (v2) unparseable date TYP-03, (v3) non-numeric amount TYP-01, (v4) overlong postal_code TYP-11.
assertions: SKILL pipeline: each planted problem quarantined with the correct taxonomy code; rows_in reconciles (accounting completeness); exit 2; raw row preserved
MEASURE baseline pipelines: crash/coerce/drop/quarantine per variant; accounting reconciliation; code labels

experiments.name: edit-propagation
experiments.setup: One decision changes: order_date format MDY -> DMY.

arms.with_skill: edit the spec's one decision line, recompile (mechanical), rerun
arms.without_skill: 1 Opus agent asked to apply the same change to its own E1 pipeline

assertions: SKILL: pipeline diff confined to the one mapping line + spec-hash header; output diff confined to order_date column; nothing else changes
MEASURE baseline: diff size/blast radius; whether outputs changed beyond order_date; whether run-report metadata reflects the change

model: opus-4.8 for all agent runs (comparability with iteration 2); baselines isolated (no repo access)
